title: WCAG 2.2 criteria
description: The WCAG 2.2 table: one row per success criterion the report answers, with the product's conformance level and remarks. Every edition reports it.

items.title: Criterion row
items.description: One criterion, its conformance level and the remarks that explain it.

criterion.title: Criterion
criterion.description: The success criterion's number, as WCAG 2.2 numbers it, such as 1.1.1. The references hold what each criterion asks, in references/wcag-2.2.md.

conformance.title: Conformance level
conformance.description: How far the product meets the criterion, as one of the five levels inputs/conformance.schema.json lists.

remarks.title: Remarks
remarks.description: What the evaluation found: where the product meets the criterion, where it does not, and what the reader should know. A line break starts a new paragraph. Left empty, the row has no remarks.
examples: Every product image has a text alternative. Two decorative icons in the settings panel are not hidden from screen readers.
Body text meets the ratio. Placeholder text in the search fields does not.
Every function can be operated from a keyboard.

if.title: A Level A or AA criterion
if.description: A row whose criterion is at WCAG 2.2's Level A or AA, the levels a report that claims conformance answers in full, as templates/criteria/wcag-level.liquid gives each criterion's level.

conformance.title: Conformance level
conformance.description: A Level A or AA criterion is never Not Evaluated: a report that leaves one unevaluated does not show conformance with WCAG 2.2. inputs/conformance.md says which level to choose.

if.title: Answered Not Evaluated
if.description: A row whose conformance level is Not Evaluated.

then.title: Says why it was not evaluated
then.description: A row answered Not Evaluated gives, in its remarks, why the evaluation did not cover the criterion.

remarks.title: Remarks
remarks.description: Why the criterion was not evaluated, such as the evaluation's scope leaving it out. A row answered Not Evaluated needs them. inputs/conformance.md says what to write.
